message.content:
The title of “best” can vary depending on criteria—critical acclaim, audience reception, awards, or personal taste—but many agree that **“Parasite”** (2019) was the standout film of 2020. It won the Academy Award for Best Picture and was praised worldwide for its sharp social commentary, genre-blending storytelling, and masterful direction by Bong Joon‑ho. If you’re looking for other highly regarded releases from that year, consider:

- **“Tenet”** – Christopher Nolan’s mind‑bending thriller (though it received mixed reviews).  
- **“Soul”** – Pixar’s heartfelt exploration of purpose and music.  
- **“1917”** – Sam Mendes’ immersive war epic (also a 2019 release but widely watched in 2020).  
- **“The Trial of the Chicago 7”** – Aaron Sorkin’s courtroom drama about political dissent.

Ultimately, the “best” depends on your interests—whether you prefer genre, narrative depth, or cultural impact.
